subject: general
question:
The given bar graph shows a company's production (in lakhs) and sales (in ₹ crores) over 4 years (2015 to 2018). Answer the question given below based on the bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77c6c8b1c89ce14f8af760752af002650a6a0e223d82be6fc3e7e40105fed08f.png] 

In which year was the value per unit ₹250?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77c6c8b1c89ce14f8af760752af002650a6a0e223d82be6fc3e7e40105fed08f.png] 

**Concept Used:**

Value per unit = (Sales)/(Production)×100

**Calculation:**

For the year 2015,

Value per unit = (Sales)/(Production) times 100

⇒ (150)/(100)times 100 =150

For the year 2016,

⇒ Value per unit = (Sales)/(Production) times 100

⇒ (350)/(250)times 100 =140

For the year 2017,

Value per unit = (Sales)/(Production) times 100

⇒ (400)/(150)times 100 = 266.67

For the year 2018,

Value per unit = (Sales)/(Production) times 100

⇒ (500)/(200)times 100 =250

**Therefore, for the year 2018, the value per unit is ₹ 250.**
